blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Few-step autoregressive video generators enable streaming generation, yet they run every token through the final denoising step, regardless of how much refinement it needs. We find this uniform computation is often unnecessary: many tokens already closely match their eventual full-step outputs in the initial steps, while others require refinement until the end. We introduce Speculative Forcing, a framework that treats intermediate clean estimates as drafts and predicts when individual tokens can be safely accepted early. Once accepted, a token is frozen as its final output and undergoes no further denoising, while its cached keys and values remain available as context for the remaining tokens. We explore two alternative verifier designs: a training-free one based on similarity to clean content and stability across steps, and a learned one that reads the frozen generator's intermediate features to estimate each token's remaining gap to its full-step output. Across short-video, long-video, and world generation, Speculative Forcing preserves the quality of full-step sampling while substantially reducing computation. On LongLive, it matches the four-step generator with ~1.7 denoising steps per token, running over 1.5x faster at 41.7 and 37.8 fps. On Lingbot-World 2.0, where camera motion continually changes the visible content, it maintains quality with ~2.5 denoising steps per token and runs 1.35x faster at 24.5 fps.
blocks.zh: 很少步骤自回式视频生成器可以使流体生成,然而它们通过最终去名步骤运行了每一个符号,无论它需要多少改进. 我们认为这种统一的计算常常是不必要的:许多符号已经在初始步骤中与最终的全步输出紧密相匹配,而其他符号则需要完善直至结束. 我们引入了Speculative Forcing,这个框架将中间清洁估计作为草稿处理,并预测单个活物何时能早日安全地被接受. 一旦被接受,一个令牌被冻结作为最终输出,不再被取消,而其缓存的密钥和值作为剩余令牌的上下文仍然可用. 我们探索两种替代的验证器设计:一种是免费的训练,基于与清洁内容的相似性和跨步骤的稳定性;另一种是学习的,读取被冷冻的生成器的中间特性,以估计出每个符号的剩余缺口与它的全步输出. 纵观短视频、长视频和世界一代,Speculative Forcing保持了全步采样的质量,同时大大减少了计算。 在"LongLive"上,它与四步发电机相匹配为~1.7去诺音阶每令牌,以41.7和37.8英尺的速度跑得快于1.5x. 在Lingbot-World 2.0上,相机运动持续地改变可见内容,它保持质量,每令牌为~2.5去诺音阶并运行速度快于24.5英尺.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Diffusion models have enabled high-quality image and video generation, with recent video models achieving realistic appearance, natural motion, and faithful prompt following ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; NVIDIA et al., 2026 ; Team Seedance et al., 2026 ) . Autoregressive (AR) video generators extend these capabilities to streaming generation ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) and interactive world models ( Team et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Seo et al., 2026 ; AlayaWorld Team et al., 2026 ) . Within a video, however, different regions may require different amounts of refinement. Some may readily reproduce familiar content from the history, while others must form newly appearing structures or resolve fine details. This raises a fundamental question: Does every token need to be denoised until the final step?
blocks.zh: 传播模式使高质量的图像和视频生成成为可能,最近的视频模式实现了现实的外观、自然运动和忠实的即时跟踪(Team Wan等人,2025年;Kong等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年b;NVIDIA等人,2026年;Team种子等人,2026年). 自动回转(AR)视频发电机将这些能力扩展到流体生成(Yin等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年a;Liu等人,2025年a)。 2025年b;Zhu等人,2026年;Lu等人,2025年)和互动世界模型(Team等人,2026年;Gao等人,2026年;He等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年;Seo等人,2026年;Alaya World) Team等人,2026年). 然而,在录像中,不同区域可能需要不同程度的改进。 有些内容可能很容易从历史中复制出熟悉的内容,而另一些则必须形成新出现的结构或解决细节问题。 这提出了一个根本问题: 在最后一步之前,是否每个标志都需要取消提名?

blocks.en: We study this question in distilled few-step AR video generators, whose intermediate predictions can already serve as plausible video outputs. Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) uses intermediate clean estimates as outputs for distribution-matching training ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) , making them natural candidates for early commitment. We observe that many tokens already approximate the generator’s own full-step output in the initial steps, while others continue changing until the last step (Figure 2 ). These differences often follow intuitive patterns. Regions that reproduce previously observed content can settle early, while nearby regions continue refining appearance or motion. Similar variation arises in world models as actions change the observed content. These observations motivate a simple principle: stop denoising tokens once they have converged, and spend the remaining computation only where refinement is still needed.
blocks.zh: 我们用蒸馏的几步AR视频生成器来研究这个问题,其中间预测已经可以作为可信的视频输出. 自强制 (Huang等人,2025年)使用中间清洁估计作为分配匹配培训的产出(Yin等人,2024年b); Yin et al., 2024a),使他们成为早期承诺的自然候选人. 我们观察到,许多符号已经在初始步骤中接近了发电机自身的全步输出,而其他符号则在最后一步(图2)之前继续改变。 这些差异往往遵循直觉规律. 复制以前观察到的内容的区域可以及早定居,而附近区域则继续精炼外观或运动. 随着行动改变观测到的内容,世界模型也出现了类似的变化。 这些观察激发了一个简单的原则:一旦信物汇合,就停止去名,而只将剩余的计算用在仍然需要改进的地方.

blocks.en: We introduce Speculative Forcing , a framework that predicts when each token’s estimate has sufficiently converged, allowing individual tokens to be accepted at different steps (Figure 1 ). Each intermediate clean estimate serves as a draft of the generator’s full-step output. A verifier determines whether to accept the draft or continue refining it. Once accepted, the estimate is fixed as the token’s output and receives no further denoising updates, while retaining its cached keys and values as context for the remaining tokens. This requires predicting whether a token’s current draft is already close to its full-step output without running the remaining denoising steps.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Speculative Forcing , 这个框架可以预测每个信使的估计数何时充分汇合, 允许单个信使在不同步骤上被接受(图1 ) 。 每一项中间清洁估计都作为发电机全步输出的草稿。 核查人决定接受草案还是继续完善草案. 估计数一旦被接受,就被固定为符号输出,并且不会收到进一步的去名更新,同时保留其缓存的密钥和值作为剩余符号的上下文. 这需要预测一个符号的当前草案是否已经接近其全步输出而不运行其余的去名步骤.

blocks.en: We address this challenge with two verifiers. Because drafts are clean latent estimates, similarity to previously generated content and changes between consecutive estimates of the same token provide evidence of convergence without additional training. Our training-free verifier uses similarity to clean history or reference content at the first step and stability between consecutive drafts at later steps. We also introduce a learned verifier for demanding settings such as world models, leveraging contextual cues encoded in the pretrained generator’s intermediate features. A shallow head trained with the generator frozen predicts each token’s gap to the full-step output, showing that the intermediate features contain cues about how much its predictions will change with further denoising. Both verifiers support token-wise acceptance without modifying the generator’s weights.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个核查员来应对这一挑战。 由于草稿是干净的潜在估计数,与以前生成的内容相似,而且同一物的连续估计数之间也发生了变化,这就证明没有经过更多的培训,就出现了趋同。 我们的无训练核查员在第一步使用与清洁历史或参考内容相似,在后步使用连续草稿之间的稳定性。 利用预先训练的生成器中间特性所编码的背景提示。 用发电机冷冻的浅头可以预测每个信使的空隙到全步输出,表明中间的特性含有提示,说明它的预测会随着进一步消音而改变多少。 两位核查员都支持以象征性方式接受,而不修改发电机的重量。

blocks.en: We evaluate Speculative Forcing on LongLive ( Yang et al., 2025a ) and the world model Lingbot-World 2.0 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) . On both short and long videos, our method maintains the quality of the four-step generator with approximately 1.7 denoising steps per token, running over 1.5 × 1.5\times faster at 41.7 and 37.8 fps. On controllable world model rollouts, a harder setting where camera motion continually changes the visible content, it maintains quality with approximately 2.5 denoising steps per token, running 1.35 × 1.35\times faster at 24.5 fps.
blocks.zh: 我们评价Speculative Forcing on LongLive(杨等人,2025a)和世界模型Lingbot-World 2.0(高等人,2026年). 在短视频和长视频上,我们的方法保持了四步发电机的质量,每节标语约1.7个去诺音阶,运行速度超过1.5×1.5\时,速度快于41.7和37.8英尺。 在可控世界模型的推出上,一个镜头运动不断改变可见内容的更难的设定,它保持质量,每令牌约2.5个去诺音阶,运行速度在24.5英尺的1.35×1.35\时更快.

blocks.en: Autoregressive Video Generation. Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models generate successive frames or chunks conditioned on preceding content ( ai et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024a ) . Distribution matching distillation ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) enables few-step generation by aligning the student’s output distribution with a target distribution represented by a pretrained teacher. CausVid applies distribution matching to distill a bidirectional teacher into a causal generator ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , while Self Forcing trains on autoregressive rollouts conditioned on the generator’s own outputs ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . Causal Forcing revisits this distillation for real-time interactive generation ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . LongLive, Rolling Forcing, and Self-Forcing++ extend few-step generation to long streaming videos ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Cui et al., 2025 ) . The same few-step AR recipe underlies real-time interactive world models, which additionally condition generation on actions or camera trajectories ( Team et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Seo et al., 2026 ; AlayaWorld Team et al., 2026 ) . These generators produce a clean latent estimate at every denoising step, not only the last, so an intermediate estimate can serve as a final output.
blocks.zh: 自动回归视频生成. 自动递归(AR)视频传播模型产生连续的帧或块,以先前的内容为条件(ai等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年;Chen等人,2024年a).分布匹配蒸馏(Yin等人,2024年b; Yin et al., 2024a)通过将学生的产出分配与由受过预训的教师代表的目标分配相配合, 实现了几步生成。 CausVid应用配给法将双向教师蒸馏成因果发生器(Yin等人,2025年),而自行推进的列车则以发电机本身的输出为条件(Huang等人,2025年)。 Causal Forcing为实时交互生成重温这种蒸馏法(Zhu等人,2026年;Zhao等人,2026年). LongLive, Rolling Forcing,和Self-Forcing++将几步生成扩展至长流视频(Yang等人,2025a; 刘等人,2025年b;Cui等人,2025年). 相同的几步AR配方是实时互动世界模式的基础,这种模式还以动作或相机轨迹为条件(Team等人,2026年;Gao等人,2026年;He等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年;Seo等人,2026年;AlayaWorld) Team等人,2026年). 这些发电机在每一个消音步骤上产生一个干净的潜在估计,不仅是最后一个,因此中间估计可以作为最后产出.

blocks.en: Adaptive Denoising. Caching methods accelerate diffusion by reusing intermediate computation across denoising steps ( Ma et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Selvaraju et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) , including reuse selected per token ( Zou et al., 2025 ) and, in AR video generation, per chunk or by local motion ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . Spatially adaptive samplers redistribute computation within the schedule, with RAS recomputing only the regions the model attends to ( Liu et al., 2026 ) and HSA evaluating each token at a different number of steps along the same noise schedule ( Chu and Patel, 2026 ) . In both cases every token is carried to the end of the schedule, so no token is ever declared finished, and the error left by the computation that was skipped has to be kept bounded by periodic full updates. Substituting a previous output also weakens as the schedule shortens, since distilled samplers leave fewer steps over which one output can stand in for the next ( Zou et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 适应性德诺瓦辛。 缓存方法通过跨去诺化步骤重新使用中间计算加快扩散(Ma等人,2023年;Chen等人,2024年b年;Selvaraju等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年a年a年),包括每只令牌选择的再利用(Zou等人,2025年),在AR视频生成中,每块或按局部运动进行再利用(Ma等人,2026年;Xu等人,2026年)。 空间适应采样器在时间表内重新分配计算,RAS只重算模型所覆盖的区域(Liu等人,2026年),HSA按照相同的噪音时间表(Chu和Patel,2026年)以不同的步骤评价每个令牌。 在这两种情况下,每个令牌都携带到时间表的末尾,所以从未宣布任何令牌完成,被跳过计算留下的错误必须以定期的完整更新为限制. 替代以前的产出也随着时间表的缩短而减弱,因为蒸馏采样器留下的台阶较少,一个产出可以支持下一个台阶(Zou等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: In Self Forcing-style generators, DSA and Surprise Forcing select denoising depth for an entire frame or chunk, assigning the same number of steps to settled and unsettled regions ( Le et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . Speculative Forcing instead treats intermediate clean estimates as drafts that can be committed at different steps according to token-wise convergence (Figure 2 ). It draws on draft verification in speculative decoding ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , without adopting its exact acceptance rule. Committed tokens receive no further denoising updates, while their cached keys and values remain as context for the remaining tokens.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Speculative Forcing allows individual tokens to stop denoising at different steps. Accepted drafts are fixed as output, while their cached keys and values provide context for tokens that continue denoising (Section 3.2 ). To determine when to accept each draft, we introduce two verifiers that predict convergence from latent estimates or the generator’s intermediate features (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 投机性强制使得个别的代币可以停止在不同步骤的发号施令. 被接受的草稿被固定为输出,而其缓存的密钥和值则为继续发号施令的符号提供了上下文(第3.2节)。 为了确定何时接受每项草案,我们提出两个核查者,根据潜在估计或生成者的中间特征预测趋同(第3.3节)。

blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en: Autoregressive video diffusion. Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models generate a video as a sequence of latent chunks { c 1 , c 2 , … } \{c_{1},c_{2},\dots\} , each containing one or more consecutive frames. The joint distribution is factorized as p ⁡ ( c 1 , c 2 , … ) = ∏ t p ⁡ ( c t ∣ c < t ) , p(c_{1},c_{2},\dots)=\prod_{t}p(c_{t}\mid c_{<t}), where each conditional distribution is modeled through a diffusion process. At inference, the model generates each chunk by progressively denoising Gaussian noise conditioned on previously generated chunks. We consider generators that use clean history ℋ t = c < t \mathcal{H}_{t}=c_{<t} as conditioning and cache its keys and values to avoid recomputing history features during subsequent generation.

blocks.en: Few-step autoregressive generation. Distilled AR video generators ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) reduce the denoising process to K K steps, enabling real-time streaming. Each chunk contains N N spatiotemporal latent tokens indexed by i i . At step k ∈ { 1 , … , K } k\in\{1,\dots,K\} , the generator takes the current noisy latent and the clean history as input and predicts a clean estimate x ^ 0 ( k ) \hat{x}_{0}^{(k)} . For k < K k<K , this estimate is re-noised to the next noise level for further denoising, and the final estimate x ^ 0 ( K ) \hat{x}_{0}^{(K)} is returned as the generated chunk.

blocks.en: These generators can be trained with distribution matching distillation ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) , which aligns their output distribution with a target distribution represented by a pretrained teacher. In particular, Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) trains on autoregressive rollouts conditioned on self-generated history and randomly selects a denoising exit step at which to evaluate the distribution-matching objective. Intermediate clean estimates thus receive supervision as generated samples, although the standard inference procedure runs every token through all K K steps.

Figure 2 shows that tokens approach the full-step output at different rates: some intermediate estimates already closely match their final values, while others continue to change. This motivates committing converged tokens while continuing to refine the rest.
Speculative Forcing treats each intermediate token estimate as a draft and uses a verifier to predict whether further denoising would substantially change it (Figure 3 ). Accepted drafts are committed as final outputs and removed from further denoising, while the remaining tokens continue to be refined.

blocks.en: 3.3 Convergence Verification

blocks.en:
To make acceptance decisions before the full-step output is available, we seek evidence of convergence in the current draft and the features used to produce it. The draft can be compared with clean content or its own previous estimate, motivating a training-free verifier. The generator’s intermediate features provide additional contextual information, which a learned verifier uses to predict the convergence gap.
Since latent tokens encode content across multiple output frames, isolated acceptance decisions can affect both spatial and temporal coherence. We therefore apply a spatiotemporal smoothing operator 𝒮 \mathcal{S} to each verifier’s scores before thresholding, encouraging coherent decisions across neighboring tokens.

为了在获得完整步骤产出之前作出接受决定,我们寻求现有草案的趋同证据以及编制草案所用的特点。 草案可以与干净的内容或它自己的先前估计相比较,从而激励一个无培训核查员。 生成器的中间特征提供了额外的背景信息,一个有学识的核查者用来预测趋同差距.
由于潜在标志将内容编码到多个输出框中,孤立的接受决定会影响空间和时间的一致性. 因此,我们在设定阈值前对每个核查员的分数使用一个瞬间平滑操作员S\mathcal{S},鼓励在相邻符号之间作出一致的决定。

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Learned Verifier

Redundancy and stability are proxies for convergence rather than convergence itself. A token can match the history and still need refinement, or change little between two steps and yet remain far from its final value. The learned verifier instead predicts the convergence gap directly from the generator’s own features. A shallow convolutional head suffices for this prediction, indicating that the intermediate features contain information about each token’s remaining discrepancy to the full-step output.

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate Speculative Forcing on autoregressive video generation and world modeling. We compare generation quality and inference speed against uniform-step sampling, and examine whether preserving settled predictions while selectively refining the remaining tokens reduces error drift during autoregressive rollouts. We further analyze the verification tolerance, token selection, and the granularity of step allocation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价Speculative Forcing 关于自动视频生成和世界建模。 我们把生成质量和推论速度与统一步骤取样进行比较,并审查在有选择地改进剩余信号的同时,是否保留既定的预测,以减少自动推出过程中的错误漂移。 我们进一步分析了核查的耐受性、物证选择和步骤分配的颗粒性。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验细节

blocks.en: Experimental setups. We apply our method to LongLive ( Yang et al., 2025a ) (1.3B) and the Causal-Fast model of Lingbot-World 2.0 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) (1.3B), both using four denoising steps. We keep both generators frozen and evaluate training-free and learned verifiers. For LongLive, we train the learned verifier on full-step rollouts from 1K VidProM ( Wang and Yang, 2024 ) prompts following the generator’s original training rollout procedure. For Lingbot, we collect training rollouts from 1K initial images with scenes disjoint from evaluation, using the same random camera-trajectory sampling and rollout protocol as evaluation. Both use the same 3-layer 3D convolutional head with negligible overhead.urs H uses the head verifier, while Ours TF uses the training-free verifier.
blocks.zh: 实验设置. 我们对LongLive(Yang等人,2025a)(1.3B)和Lingbot-World 2.0(Gao等人,2026年)(1.3B)的Causal-Fast模型应用了我们的方法,两者都采用了四个去名步骤. 我们把发电机都冷冻起来 并且评估无训练的和有学识的核查员 对LongLive来说,我们从1K VidProM开始 训练有学问的核查员 (Wang and Yang, 2024) 提示遵循发电机最初的训练推出程序. 对于Lingbot,我们从1K的初始图像中收集到与评价脱节的场景的训练推广,使用与评价相同的随机相机-传导取样和推出协议. 两者都使用相同的3层3D旋动头部,可忽略不计.urs. blocks.en: Evaluation. For LongLive, we evaluate 5-second videos using the VBench prompts rewritten by Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , with five random seeds per prompt, and report all 16 VBench dimensions ( Huang et al., 2023 ) . We also generate 30-second videos with the same prompt set and evaluate all 16 dimensions using VBench-Long ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , following the protocol of LongLive ( Yang et al., 2025a ) .

blocks.en: We further evaluate Lingbot on 200 held-out navigation scenes to examine performance under substantial changes in visible content and pronounced intermediate distortions. Each scene provides an initial image, a text prompt, and a camera trajectory composed of five segments with randomly sampled camera actions and motion speeds. We generate 253 frames per scene and report a VBench quality aggregate over six dimensions, excluding temporal flickering. We also report relative camera-pose error against the commanded ground-truth trajectory to assess whether accelerated sampling follows the camera path as faithfully as the four-step generator. For both long videos and world model rollouts, we additionally report the Drift metric of Reward Forcing ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , which measures temporal variation in imaging quality across video segments. All methods share the same conditioning inputs and sampling seeds. Metric definitions and benchmark construction are detailed in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估Lingbot在200个被搁置的导航场景,以在可见内容的重大变化和明显的中间扭曲下检查性能. 每个场景提供初始图像,文本提示,以及由五个段组成的相机轨迹,随机取样的相机动作和运动速度. 我们每个场景生成253帧 并报告一个V Bench质量总量 超过六个维度,不包括时间闪烁。 我们还报告相机与指令的地面真实轨迹的相对误差,以评估加速取样是否如四步发电机一样忠实地遵循相机路径。 对于长视频和世界模型的推出,我们另外报告 " 奖励 Forcing " 的漂流度量度(Lu等人,2025年),该度量了各视频段成像质量的时间变化。 所有方法共用相同的调制输入和取样种子。 计量定义和基准构建详见附录B。

blocks.en: Short video generation. Table 1 compares generation quality and efficiency on 5-second videos. Both verifiers maintain the overall VBench performance of the four-step generator while using fewer than 1.7 denoising steps per token on average. By accepting settled predictions early and continuing to refine the remaining tokens, our method preserves generation quality with less than half the denoising token evaluations of the original schedule.

blocks.en: Long video generation. Table 2 reports results on long video generation. The training-free verifier retains competitive quality with a small loss in consistency, while the learned verifier maintains both the quality and consistency of the four-step generator. Both verifiers use approximately 1.7 denoising steps per token on average and achieve lower Drift than the four-step generator. Both also maintain comparable dynamic degree, suggesting that the reduced quality variation is not simply a consequence of suppressing motion.

blocks.en: World generation. Table 3 reports results on world generation, a more challenging setting in which camera control induces substantial changes across the visible scene. Accordingly, our methods tend to allocate more denoising steps than in standard video generation. Despite this increased difficulty, the training-free verifier remains competitive in quality while maintaining low Drift. The learned verifier preserves quality and consistency comparable to the four-step generator while achieving lower Drift. Camera-pose errors against the commanded trajectory also remain comparable, indicating that acceleration preserves camera-following accuracy.
blocks.zh: 世界一代报. 表3汇报了世界一代的情况,一个更具挑战性的环境,即摄像机控制在可见的场景中诱发实质性的变化。 因此,我们的方法倾向于分配比标准视频生成更多的去名步骤。 尽管难度增加,但无培训核查员在质量上仍然具有竞争力,同时保持低飘流。 学习的核查员保持了质量和一致性,与四步生成器相当,同时实现了较低的漂流. 相机与指令轨迹的相机误差也仍然具有可比性,表明加速度保持了相机跟随的准确性.

blocks.en: Qualitative results. Figure 4 compares our generations with the corresponding four-step generators. On both LongLive and Lingbot, our method preserves visual quality comparable to four-step generation without noticeable degradation over time. On LongLive, it maintains subject identity and image quality even in scenes with dynamic objects. On Lingbot, previously observed regions remain coherent under large camera motion, while newly revealed regions are further refined, yielding consistent transitions between accepted and refined areas.
blocks.zh: 定性结果. 图4将我们的几代人与相应的四步发电机进行比较。 在LongLive和Lingbot上,我们的方法保持了可与四步生成相比的视觉质量,没有随着时间的推移出现明显的退化. 在LongLive上,它保持了主题身份和图像质量,甚至在有动态物体的场景中也是如此. 在Lingbot上,以前观测到的区域在大相机运动下仍保持连贯,而新发现的区域则得到进一步完善,从而在被接受和精炼的区域之间产生一致的过渡.

blocks.en: We examine how verification tolerance, verification signals, and acceptance granularity affect generation quality and efficiency. Figure 5 provides representative qualitative comparisons of the alternative policies. We further evaluate how accurately each verification signal predicts the oracle in Appendix C.1 and provide additional ablations on our head in Appendix C.2 .

Increasing ϵ \epsilon reduces mean denoising steps, with ϵ = 0.20 \epsilon=0.20 and ϵ = 0.24 \epsilon=0.24 maintaining the four-step generator’s quality while achieving lower Drift. Larger tolerances accept insufficiently refined drafts and degrade quality, highlighting the need to balance early acceptance with further refinement.

Premature chunk-wise acceptance propagates errors to later chunks, while motion-based verification struggles to distinguish camera-induced changes from distortions.

blocks.en: Effect of verification signals. We adapt two existing selection criteria to token-wise commitment in latent space. Inspired by MotionCache ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , we measure temporal differences between adjacent latent frames at the same spatial position. We also adapt RAS’s predicted-noise dispersion signal ( Liu et al., 2026 ) to the channel variance of each predicted clean latent token. Thresholds are calibrated on held-out data to obtain comparable mean denoising steps. As shown in Table 5 , both adapted signals yield lower quality than our learned verifier and uniform sampling at similar mean steps. Temporal differences, for example, can reflect both camera-induced changes and intermediate distortions, limiting their reliability as convergence signals (Figure 5 ). These results support directly predicting each draft’s remaining convergence gap.
blocks.zh: 核查信号的效果。 我们调整了现有的两项选择标准,以在潜在空间作出象征性承诺。 在MotionCache(徐等人,2026年)的启发下,我们在同一空间位置测量邻近潜在框架之间的时间差异。 我们还将RAS的预测噪声散射信号(Liu等人,2026年)适应每个预测的清洁潜伏物的通道差异。 阈值在被搁置数据上进行校准,以获得可比较的平均去诺步骤。 如表5所示,两个经调整的信号的质量都低于我们所学的核实器,并在类似的平均步骤下进行统一取样。 例如,时间差异既可以反映相机引起的变化,也可以反映中间扭曲,限制其作为趋同信号的可靠性(图5 )。 这些结果直接有助于预测每个草案仍然存在的趋同差距。

blocks.en: Comparison with oracle verification. We additionally evaluate an oracle verifier that computes the full-step reference for each chunk using the same initial noise and conditioning, then uses the measured convergence gaps to determine token acceptance. We apply the same tolerance and spatiotemporal smoothing as the learned verifier. Our learned verifier achieves generation quality comparable to oracle verification without computing the full-step reference at inference (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 与甲骨文校验比较. 我们进一步评价一个甲骨文核查器,该核查器使用相同的初始噪声和条件计算每个块的全步引用,然后使用测量到的趋同差距来确定符号接受. 我们的容忍度和瞬间平滑度与学得的核实者相同。 我们所学的核查者实现了与甲骨文核查相似的生成质量,而不计算推断时的全步骤参考(表5).

blocks.en: Effect of token-wise commitment. Adaptive denoising has been explored at frame and chunk granularity ( Le et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . To isolate commitment granularity, we use the same learned verifier but accept an entire chunk when its mean predicted convergence gap falls below a threshold at each step. The threshold is calibrated on held-out data against the oracle criterion to match our mean denoising steps. As shown in Table 5 , token-wise commitment achieves higher quality and lower Drift at comparable mean denoising steps. Chunk-wise acceptance cannot distinguish tokens that have already converged from those that continue to change, resulting in lower quality and higher Drift when all tokens share the same acceptance step (Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh: 象征性承诺的效果。 已在框架和块颗粒性方面探索了适应性的去诺化(Le等人,2026年;Shi等人,2026年)。 为了隔离承诺的颗粒性,我们使用同一学得的核实器,但当平均预测的汇合差距在每一步骤低于阈值时,我们接受整块。 阈值根据预言标准 来校准被扣数据 以匹配我们的平均去诺步骤 如表5所示,象征性承诺在可比较的平均去名步骤下,能达到更高的质量和较低的漂流量。 春格式接受无法区分已经汇合的符号和继续变化的符号,导致当所有符号都共享相同的接受步骤时质量更低,漂流率更高(图5).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced Speculative Forcing , a framework that allocates denoising computation according to token-wise convergence in few-step autoregressive video generation. By treating intermediate clean estimates as drafts, it predicts which tokens can be accepted early and continues denoising only the remaining tokens. Training-free and learned verifiers enable these decisions without modifying the generator’s weights. Experiments on short and long videos and controllable world model rollouts demonstrate faster generation while maintaining quality, with comparable or lower quality variation and preserved camera-following accuracy in world modeling. These results show that a shared denoising depth is not necessary for every token, supporting convergence-based acceptance as a practical approach to efficient video generation.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Speculative Forcing ,这个框架根据象征性的趋同,在几步的自动视频生成中分配去诺计算. 通过将中间清洁估计作为草稿处理,它预测哪些符号可以早日被接受,并继续只去除剩余的符号. 免费和有学识的核查员可以使这些决定不改变生成者的重量。 短视频和长视频的实验以及可控世界模型的推出表明,在保持质量的同时,生成速度更快,其质量差异相当或较低,并保持了世界模型制作中的相机跟踪精度。 这些结果表明,并非每个标志都有必要有一个共同的代言深度,支持基于趋同的接受,作为高效视频生成的实用方法。

blocks.en: We retain the released backbone configurations except for the denoising policies evaluated in this work. For LongLive ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , we use an attention sink of 3 latent frames, a local attention window of 12 latent frames, and 3 latent frames per chunk. Short and long videos contain 81 and 477 frames, respectively. For Lingbot-World 2.0 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , we use the 1.3B Causal-Fast model with an attention sink of 6 latent frames, a local attention window of 18 latent frames, and 4 latent frames per chunk. Each benchmark video contains 253 frames. Lingbot-World 2.0 additionally receives a per-frame camera trajectory encoded through Plücker embeddings derived from relative camera-to-world poses. We retain the original camera-conditioning pathway, including per-video translation normalization by the maximum translation magnitude. For the main results, the training-free thresholds ( τ red , τ stab ) (\tau_{\mathrm{red}},\tau_{\mathrm{stab}}) are ( 0.497 , 0.327 ) (0.497,0.327) for 5-second LongLive videos, ( 0.357 , 0.235 ) (0.357,0.235) for 30-second LongLive videos, and ( 0.375 , 0.300 ) (0.375,0.300) for Lingbot-World 2.0.
blocks.zh: 我们保留了释放出来的骨干配置,但这项工作评估的取消提名政策除外。 对LongLive(Yang等人,2025年a)来说,我们使用3个潜在框架、12个潜在框架和3个每个块的潜在框架的局部关注窗口。 短片和长片分别包含81帧和477帧. 对于Lingbot-World 2.0(Gao等人,2026年),我们使用1.3B Causal-Fast模型,其注意力池为6个潜伏帧,局部注意力窗口为18个潜伏帧,每块4个潜伏帧. 每个基准视频包含253帧. Lingbot-World 2.0额外接收通过Plücker嵌入从相对相机对世界的姿势中衍生出来的每帧相机轨迹编码. 我们保留了最初的照相机空调路径,包括按最大翻译量实现每集翻译正常化。 对于主要结果,无训练阈值(\tau_{\mathrm{red}},\tau_{\mathrm{stab}})为(0.497,0.327)5秒长生视频(0.357,0.235)30秒长生视频(0.357,0.235),(0.375,0.300)Lingbot-World2.0.

blocks.en: We retain the original denoising schedules so that early commitment operates on the intermediate clean estimates supervised during distribution-matching training. In our configurations, LongLive and Lingbot-World 2.0 share the shifted timesteps [ 1000.0,937.5,833.3,625.0 ] [1000.0,937.5,833.3,625.0] , obtained from a 1000-step flow-matching schedule with a shift of 5.0 5.0 . A token accepted at step k k undergoes exactly the first k k steps of this schedule. Uniform-step baselines use the same prefixes, allowing us to compare token-wise acceptance with a shared exit step along the same trained denoising trajectory.
blocks.zh: 我们保留了最初的取消提名时间表,以便及早根据分配匹配培训期间监督的中间清洁估计数作出承诺。 在我们的配置中,LongLive和Lingbot-World 2.0共享变换的时序[1000.0,937.5,833.3,625.0][1000.0,937.5,833.3,625.0],从1000步的流量比对时间表中获得,变换为5.05.0. 步骤 k k 所接受的符号恰恰是本时间表中的第一个步骤 k 。 统一步骤的基线使用相同的前缀,使我们能够将象征性接受与同一训练有素的去Noing轨迹上的共享退出步骤进行比较。

blocks.en: The learned verifier reads hidden states from the generator’s final transformer block without an additional backbone forward. The head consists of layer normalization and three 3D convolutions with channel dimensions 1536 → 96 → 48 → 1 1536\to 96\to 48\to 1 . The first two convolutions use 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 kernels with GELU activations, and the last uses a 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 kernel. The head’s output is average-pooled over 2 × 2 × 2 2\times 2\times 2 token blocks and expanded back to the original grid using nearest-neighbor interpolation. The head has 4.11M parameters and is shared across denoising steps. We train only the head using the smooth- ℓ 1 \ell_{1} loss and Adam with a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} and batch size 4.

Within each chunk, accepted tokens retain the layer-wise keys and values computed at their acceptance step, while active tokens update theirs as denoising continues. The cache can therefore contain KV states from different denoising steps. Once the chunk is complete, the generator performs a clean forward pass over the assembled output at timestep 0 0 , refreshing the KV states of all tokens regardless of their acceptance steps. Subsequent chunks thus attend to history states computed from the completed clean output.
blocks.zh: 在每个块中,被接受的令牌保留其接受步骤时计算的分层密钥和值,而活动令牌则随着解密的继续更新它们的. 因此缓存可以包含来自不同去诺步骤的KV状态. 一旦块完成,生成器在0时完成组装输出,刷新所有符号的KV状态,而不论其接受步骤如何。 因此,随后的块涉及从完成的清洁产出中计算的历史状态。

blocks.en: We apply spatiotemporal smoothing to each verifier’s score map before thresholding at every verification step. Spatial smoothing uses a normalized 9 × 9 9\times 9 Gaussian kernel with a standard deviation of 1.0 token and reflect padding, applied independently to each latent frame. Temporal smoothing then averages scores over the current and subsequent latent frames within the same chunk, using Gaussian weights with a standard deviation of 1.0 latent frame.
blocks.zh: 我们先对每个核查者的分数图进行瞬间平滑处理,然后才能在每一个核查步骤设定阈值。 空间平滑使用一个规范化的9×9 9\times 9高斯内核,标准偏差为1.0令牌并反映粘贴,独立应用于每个潜在框架. 时间平滑后,平均比对同一块内当前和随后的潜伏框架得分,使用高斯加权,标准偏差为1.0潜伏框架.

blocks.en: Only tokens that have not yet been accepted are forwarded through the generator at subsequent denoising steps. We reduce execution overhead through shared indexing and in-place KV updates. We also merge each chunk’s clean pass with the next chunk’s first denoising pass while preserving timestep conditioning, attention dependencies, and KV update order. All baselines use the same applicable execution optimizations for fair throughput comparisons.
blocks.zh: 只有尚未接受的代号才在随后的去名步骤中通过生成器传送. 我们通过共享索引和现场KV更新来减少执行费。 我们还将每个块的干净通行证与下一个块的首次解密通行证合并,同时保留时间步调、注意力依赖和KV更新顺序。 所有基线都采用相同的适用执行优化,以进行公平的吞吐量比较。

blocks.en: B.1 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: B.1 评价计量

blocks.en: We follow VBench ( Huang et al., 2023 ) for 5-second videos and VBench-Long ( Huang et al., 2024 ) for 30-second videos for LongLive, reporting all 16 dimensions. For Lingbot-World 2.0, we aggregate six quality dimensions using VBench’s official normalization and weights, excluding temporal flickering because intended camera motion can produce frame-to-frame pixel changes. Following Reward Forcing ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , we measure Drift as the standard deviation of imaging-quality scores across non-overlapping 2-second segments, averaged over videos. We use VBench’s MUSIQ model and preprocessing, with 7 complete segments per Lingbot evaluation and 15 segments per 30-second LongLive evaluation. Lower Drift indicates more consistent imaging quality over time.
blocks.zh: 我们跟随V Bench(Huang等人,2023年)拍摄5秒的视频,和V Bench-Long(Huang等人,2024年)拍摄LongLive的30秒视频,报告所有16个维度. 对Lingbot-World 2.0来说,我们利用V Bench的官方常态和权重将6个质量维度汇总起来,不包括时间闪烁,因为预期的相机运动可以产生帧到帧像素的变化. 继Reward Forcing(Lu等人,2025年)之后,我们把漂流作为成像质量分数的标准偏差,跨越非重叠的2秒段,平均比对视频. 我们使用V Bench的MUSIQ模型和预处理,每Lingbot评价7个完整段,每30秒长寿评价15个段. 下游漂流表明,随着时间的推移,图像质量更加一致。

blocks.en: For Lingbot-World 2.0, we measure relative pose error (RPE) against the commanded ground-truth camera trajectory. We recover camera poses using Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) and apply Sim3 Umeyama alignment to the commanded trajectory independently for each of the five camera-control segments, yielding 1,000 segments across 200 videos. We compare relative transformations between consecutive frames. Rot is the mean angular error over all frame pairs, in degrees. Trans is the sum of translation errors divided by the sum of commanded displacements over all pairs, and is dimensionless. This protocol evaluates local camera-following accuracy under the same reconstruction and alignment procedure for all methods.
blocks.zh: 对于Lingbot-World 2.0,我们对照指令的地面真实相机轨迹来测量相对摆设错误(RPE). 我们使用深度Anything 3(Lin等人,2025年)来回收相机姿势,并将Sim3 Umeyama对齐独立应用于5个相机控制片段的指令轨迹,在200个视频中产生1000个片段. 我们比较了连续帧之间的相对变化。 rot是所有帧对上的平均角误差,以度计. Trans(trans)是翻译错误的总和,除以所有对齐的受命移位的总和,是无维的. 本协议在对所有方法的相同重建和对齐程序下,评价局部相机的准确性.

blocks.en: To quantify denoising computation, we report the average number of denoising evaluations per token across all chunks and videos, excluding the clean pass used to refresh the KV cache. We measure throughput on a single NVIDIA H100 as the number of generated frames divided by the DiT forward time, excluding VAE encoding and decoding.
blocks.zh: 为了量化去命名计算,我们报告所有块和视频中每个信物去命名评价的平均数量,不包括用于刷新KV缓存的干净通行证. 我们测量一个单一的NVIDIA H100上的吞吐量,作为由DiT前置时间除以生成帧的数量,不包括VAE编码和解码.

blocks.en: B.2 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: B.2 基准建设

blocks.en:
We construct a fixed benchmark of 200 scenes for Lingbot-World 2.0, each consisting of an initial image, a text prompt, and a camera trajectory. All methods use the same conditioning inputs and sampling seeds. Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2025 ) generates scene descriptions spanning diverse categories and visual styles, and Z-Image-Turbo ( Image Team et al., 2026 ) generates the initial images at 1376 × 768 1376\times 768 . The image and video models receive the same scene prompt, combining environment, subject, and perspective descriptions. After fixing the benchmark, we construct the verifier’s training set from separate scenes using the same pipeline, filtering potential overlap through text and image similarity.
Each video contains 253 frames, with the 252 camera transitions divided into five consecutive control segments of lengths 50, 50, 50, 50, and 52. For each segment, we uniformly sample an action from forward, backward, strafe left, strafe right, yaw left, yaw right, and stop, excluding the preceding segment’s action. Across the benchmark, this produces 593 translation, 276 rotation, and 131 stationary segments. Translation speeds are sampled from 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0.2 , 1.0 ) \mathcal{U}(0.2,1.0) , with the fastest translation segment in each video set to 1.0 1.0 to match the model’s per-video translation normalization. Yaw rates are sampled from 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0.6 , 2.0 ) \mathcal{U}(0.6,2.0) degrees per frame. We choose the lower bound based on preliminary tests in which smaller commands produced little visible rotation. Camera intrinsics follow the official adapter defaults and remain fixed across methods.

blocks.en: D.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: D.1 限制

blocks.en: The achievable acceleration depends on both the underlying generator and the difficulty of the generation domain. If the backbone is sensitive to reducing denoising steps, fewer tokens can be accepted early without degrading generation quality, which limits the attainable speedup. Similarly, more challenging domains may require additional refinement across a larger fraction of tokens. This is evident in world generation, where large viewpoint changes introduce stronger distortions than standard video generation and result in higher mean denoising steps, as shown in Table 3 . Our method therefore does not guarantee the same acceleration across different generators or domains.
blocks.zh: 可实现的加速既取决于潜在的生成器,也取决于生成域的难度. 如果骨干对降低降级阶梯很敏感,那么可以在不降低生成质量的情况下提前接受更少的代币,这限制了可实现的加速. 同样,更具挑战性的领域可能需要在更大比例的标志上作进一步的改进。 这在世界一代人中是显而易见的,如表3所示,大视角的变化带来了比标准视频生成更强烈的扭曲,并导致更高的刻意去除步骤。 因此,我们的方法不能保证在不同发电机或领域实现同样的加速。

blocks.en: D.3 Potential Applications
blocks.zh: D.3 潜在应用

blocks.en: Our experiments focus on general video generation and world modeling, but token-wise commitment may be particularly effective when much of the target content is already constrained by available conditions. In talking-head generation ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , for example, the background can remain largely unchanged while motion is concentrated around the face and upper body. In environment-grounded world models such as Seoul World Model ( Seo et al., 2026 ) and World Observer ( Choi et al., 2026 ) , warped scene observations and reference images provide visual evidence for parts of the target view, while uncovered regions require new content to be generated. Dexterous World Models ( Kim et al., 2025 ) provide static scene renderings along the camera trajectory and generate interaction-induced changes while preserving unaffected content.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验侧重于一般的视频生成和世界建模,但是,如果许多目标内容已经受到现有条件的限制,象征性的承诺可能特别有效。 例如,在说话头一代(黄等人,2026年)中,背景基本上可以保持不变,而运动则集中在面部和上部。 在首尔世界模型(Seo et al., 2026)和世界观察者(Choi et al., 2026)等基于环境的世界模型中,扭曲的场景观测和参考图像为部分目标视图提供了视觉证据,而被发现的区域则需要生成新的内容. Dexterous世界模式 (Kim等人,2025年)沿相机轨迹提供静态场景渲染,产生相互作用引起的变化,同时保留未受影响的内容.

blocks.en: These settings offer opportunities to allocate denoising computation according to how much refinement remains after conditioning. Tokens already reproducing content supported by scene conditions or references may be accepted early, while newly generated or dynamically changing regions receive further refinement. Extending token-wise commitment to these settings could also support efficient augmented and virtual reality applications that combine known environments with generated content and interaction dynamics.
blocks.zh: 这些设置提供了根据条件调整后的完善程度来分配解密计算的机会。 在现场条件或参考文献支持下已经复制内容的Tokens可能很早就被接受,而新生成或动态变化的区域则得到进一步的完善. 将象征性的承诺扩展到这些环境,还可以支持高效的扩大和虚拟现实应用,将已知环境与生成的内容和互动动态结合起来。
